name: @equin/plugin-reports-render-loop-activity
description: Page activity the render-loop detector's idle gate counts besides this tab's own input: holdPlayback() while a playback timeline runs (a player rendering on its clock), and markRemoteInput() where another tab's write is handed to a reader in this page (a draft typed there, redrawn here). A leaf library, so any primitive can mark activity without depending on the detector.
